ORTHOPAEDIC SURGERY

Antimicrobial prophylaxis is not recommended for most clean procedures,

including knee, hand or foot procedures, arthroscopy, or other procedures

without implantation of foreign materials.

Prophylaxis is indicated for internal fixation of fracture, total joint

replacement, and any implanted foreign body. Open fractures should be treated

as infected.

Cefazolin is preferred for prophylaxis, as it is more active than vancomycin

against susceptible staphylococci, the most common surgical pathogens.

Vancomycin should be used in patients who are colonized or recently infected

with methicilin-resistant Staphlococcus aureus (MRSA).

Prophylaxis beyond 24 hours is not supported by current data and guidelines.

Longer durations provide no additional benefit and are associated with

side effects, increased costs, and bacterial resistance.

Also, there is no evidence of benefit of antimicrobial administration until

all drains or catheters are removed.

# Clean procedures of hand, knee, and foot:

[Click here No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended for procedure](orz-gtx-abx-pre-op-url-nurse-generic-order)

# Prophylaxis recommendations for the following surgeries:

Internal fixation of fracture, total joint replacement, any implanted

foreign body

# Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

Prophylaxis recommendation includes q8h for 2 doses post-op. Please place

post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order from orthopedic standing post-op orders

AFTER patient is admitted.

# Alternative for patients with beta lactam allergy:

[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Weight Based Dosing Preop R](orzid2-gmenu-surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

Prophylaxis recommendation includes q12h for 1 dose post-op. Please place

post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order from orthopedic standing post-op orders

AFTER patient is admitted.

# Known MRSA colonization:

[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Weight Based Dosing Preop R](orzid2-gmenu-surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

Prophylaxis recommendation includes q12h for 1 dose post-op. Please place

post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order from orthopedic standing post-op orders

AFTER patient is admitted.

References:

Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis

in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013, vol 70 pages 195-283
